name: Reinforced armory (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Single-storey reinforced armory, 15.2 x 10 m: 0.4 m cast concrete walls on a formwork-textured finish, thick roof slab with a low parapet, steel double front door and a steel rear loading door, small barred high windows. Inside: an issue room with a fixed steel-and-laminate issue counter under a mesh security screen with a lift-up flap, two lockable weapon cages of welded mesh with rifle racks behind the counter, and two ammunition stores behind steel doors. Blast bollards, warning panels, lights and cameras outside.
